phase_3_bridge_between_branches.meaning: Micro orientation-state evolution (Schrodinger_app) accumulates. When this discrete relational pressure crosses the scale threshold (tau), it stabilizes into coarse field_app and projects as macro geometry_app (Field_equation_app).
phase_3_bridge_between_branches.notes: field_equation_app emerges when many Schrodinger_app updates cross tau. This demonstrates the cross-basin scale translation mechanism without invoking physical unification.
